eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; Pima, AZ; at 7:38 PM on AUG 31, 2026 Effective until 3:38 AM SEP 1, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A safe Alert has been issued for Pima County. The Pima County Sheriff is looking for 68-year-old Denise Kay Rose. Denise is a white female 5 feet tall, 100 pounds, with blue eyes and blonde hair. Denise was last seen wearing a white shirt and blue jean shorts and straw hat. Denise was last seen on 08/31/2026 at 9:00 A.M. on foot near 3400 block of East Alvord Road, Tucson. Denise suffers from a medical condition which may cause her to become lost or easily confused. Please call 911 with information. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
